name: Israel, Gaza & region
summary: Saudi forces intercept Houthi missiles aimed at Najran; Israeli strikes kill four in Gaza despite ceasefire
state: Saudi forces intercepted two Houthi ballistic missiles aimed at Najran on 6 Nov (CBS News), and Houthi-run media said Saudi strikes killed at least 30 people in Taiz province (Al Jazeera). Israeli strikes and gunfire killed four people, including a boy, in Gaza on 5 Nov despite the ceasefire (Gulf Today). The US–Iran war continues, so several fronts are active at once.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for Israel, Lebanon, Yemen, Saudi Arabia and the Gulf, which can change at short notice. Flights in the region may be disrupted.
rubric_hit: Alert: multi-front escalation (US–Iran war, Yemen–Saudi strikes, Gaza)

sources.title: Al Jazeera — Iran war live: IRGC says US drone downed, tankers hit in Strait of Hormuz
Gulf Today — Israeli strikes, gunfire kill boy, three others in Gaza

why: Conflict involving Israel, Gaza, Lebanon, Syria and Yemen threatens civilians, shipping and wider escalation. Direct hostilities with Iran are tracked under Gulf / US–Iran war.
drivers: Ceasefire status, Iran-linked groups, hostage talks, humanitarian access, US posture.

rubric.alert: Multi-front escalation, major cross-border strikes between Israel and its neighbours, or mass-casualty events.
rubric.watch: Ongoing hostilities on one front, or a ceasefire repeatedly violated.
rubric.normal: Ceasefires holding across fronts (Gaza, Lebanon, Syria, Yemen).
